why: Caches elements outside this document's tree. jsdom clears nothing for a detached element's changes, so only its next focus clear makes a fresh read right; an element of another document is cleared by that document's `_clearStyleCache`, which this cache does not hook; and a shadow root's sheets are not in `document.styleSheets`, so the focus-state guard never reads its `:focus-within` rule. Each case reads a value the cache would hold stale.
killedBy: computed-style-cache: reads it never caches passes a detached element through, so a focus move cannot strand its value
computed-style-cache: reads it never caches passes an element in a shadow root through, whose sheets the guard never reads
computed-style-cache: reads it never caches passes an element of another document through, whose clears this cache does not count
